profile.tagline: 15 years experience in digital product development — from idea to commercialization with product management, SEO and digital marketing approach

about: I am Mohammad Hamza; a full-stack web and mobile app developer, SEO and digital marketing specialist with 15 years of professional experience in East Azerbaijan, Iran. I am the founder and manager of the Starteach team (starteach.ir), which develops various digital products remotely with specialists from all over Iran. Our focus is on creating educational platforms, practical software, educational content for professors and students, employment exam resources, research AI, and course marketplace. With over 60 successful products including 25 Android software and web applications, I accompany you from the ideation stage to design, development, SEO, marketing and commercialization.

aboutPm.title: Product Management — From Idea to Commercialization
aboutPm.text: In every project, I take on the role of product manager: defining vision, designing MVP, managing remote team, scheduling, technical development, SEO, marketing, content production and market entry. This approach has made my products not just code, but real businesses with audience and revenue.
